messages:
zoe: Heads up - used the corp card for an airport ride yesterday. Bank posted 'LYFT *REDWOOD' $67.50. I have two PDFs: one shows fare $54.00 + airport surcharge $8.50, the other is a separate tip receipt for $5.00. How do I record split items? Manager approved the trip.
miguel: @zoe upload both receipts to Expensify and add a short note splitting fare vs surcharge vs tip. We need manager sign-off for tips on corp card.
zoe: Uploaded `ride_6789_fare.pdf` and `ride_6789_tip.pdf`. Note says: "Airport pickup to SJC office, manager: Elaine, tip included on separate receipt".
elaine: I approved the business ride. No personal stop. Tip is fine — it was for a client pickup.
ryan: For GL, we'll code $54.00 -> ground-transport:rides (GL 6300), $8.50 -> travel:airport-fees (GL 6325), and $5.00 tip -> travel:tips (GL 6390). Finance: do we need any extra paperwork for separate tip receipt?
finance-bot: Policy: tips on corporate card are allowed up to 20% for ground transport with manager approval and an itemized receipt. If tip is on a separate merchant record, attach both receipts and include manager approval. Transactions under $100 with receipts and manager approval process automatically in 3-5 business days.
miguel: Thanks @elaine @zoe. @ryan please reconcile in the GL sheet; AP will split the single bank transaction into three lines in the ledger. If the bank later aggregates differently, AP will reclassify. Closing once posted.
zoe: Thanks all — changed the receipt filename to `receipt_6789_last4.pdf` and added the manager approval text in Expensify. :white_check_mark:
finance-bot: Note: recommended filename format `receipt_<last4>_<shortdesc>.pdf` for faster recon.
